about: Server code for Shopwatch: custom API endpoints and scheduled tasks. Each file is the handler body as written; the platform adds its own wrapper (sign-in check, helpers) when it runs. Environment variable values are never included in an export; only their names are listed.

endpoints.description: Add a public HTTPS Shopify storefront to the signed-in owner’s private monitoring list.
Allow a verified app admin to add a monitored store for a client.
Let a verified app admin update a fix request’s status.
Return a cross-store admin overview after verifying the caller’s signed app role.
Create a verified store owner’s fix request and notify the app administrator by transactional email.
Return this account’s monitoring data, including stores that the app admin added on its behalf.
Check the public Shopify store, shopper paths and safe temporary cart flow; refresh or compare the baseline, then email the verified owner when a problem appears.
Serve one storefront screenshot using its unguessable per-image access token.
Update a verified store owner’s alert email and ignored content terms.

scheduled_tasks.name: shopwatch-daily-checks
scheduled_tasks.description: Run Shopwatch storefront checks once daily in bounded batches, save check history and alerts, and notify owners when a problem is found.
